canonical_name: Existence and uniqueness for stochastic differential equations
canonical_statement: Candidate pending primary-source freeze: a finite-dimensional Ito SDE driven by Brownian motion, with coefficients satisfying a source-selected global Lipschitz and linear-growth condition and a suitable initial random variable, has an adapted strong solution unique up to the source-selected pathwise equality convention.

quantifiers: filtered probability space and Brownian motion
hypotheses: initial-variable integrability and independence conditions required by the source
conclusion: Existence of a strong adapted solution satisfying the integral SDE and pathwise uniqueness under an exact equality convention, all pending source freeze.
